Requirement: 
 Position: Front End Developer 

 Job Location: Ft. Worth, TX 76155 
 Duration:7+ Months Contract (possibility of conversion into full time) 
 Job Description:  

 This Front-end Developer (FED) will be responsible for making AAVACATIONS.com compliant with web accessibility standards. This person will work closely with business owners, product owners, business analysts, project managers, UX leadership and graphic designers, developers and tech leads. This person will work effectively using the Agile project methodology. It is essential to have a flexible attitude and excellent communication skills. 
 Key Job Responsibilities: 
 Produce and deliver final assets using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript (jQuery, jQueryUI, etc.). 
 Produce technical solutions throughout the entire product lifecycle, from initial explorations through final design deliverables such as screen layouts, user interface elements, and prototypes  

 Translate usability and field research findings into design/function improvements  

 Collaborate with AA.com User Experience, Interactive Marketing and Publishing teams to develop cross-product solutions  

 Document front-end technology standards and procedures  

 Skill Set Required: 
 Mastery of HTML5 and CSS3 and object oriented JavaScript coding 
 Mastery of responsive and adaptive web development techniques  

 Mastery of cross-browser compatibility concerns  

 Proficiency with jQuery, jQueryUI, jQuery Plugins or similar JavaScript libraries  

 Proficiency in creating accessible solutions conforming to WGAC 2.0 Level AA guidelines  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving skills, customer service and interpersonal skills  

 Skill Set Preferred: 

 Proficiency with responsive frameworks such as Foundation and Bootstrap  

 


 Must Have: 

 HTML 5 * 

 JavaScript *
 Agile Methodology *
 Excellent Written and Oral Communication Skills *
 Education/Experience: 
 5+ years experience required  

 Bachelor degree in computer science or equivalent experience required 

 


 
 Thanks & Regards, 
 Caroline Ignetious
